# ServiceNow release notes — captured 2026-08-10
# https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/release-notes/family-release-notes.html

Still the **Australia** family. Page "Updated August 7, 2026". The family index itself carries no
GA-date assertions, as before.

## HELD ITEM RESOLVED THIS SCAN — AI Control Tower / AI Gateway
Carried since 2026-05-05 (press release) and held on the 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-09 scans because the
forecast "GA expected August 2026" was never asserted in the docs. Resolved 2026-08-10 by reading
the per-application release notes instead of the family index:

**AI Control Tower** — servicenow.com/docs/r/release-notes/ai-control-tower-rn.html
Available in the **Australia release**, distributed via the **ServiceNow Store** (request to
install). Described as "enhanced and updated in the Australia release" — i.e. shipping, not
Innovation Lab. The forecast is effectively met, though the docs never use the words "generally
available" with a date. Redesigned, with these NEW Australia capabilities:
  - **Activity Center** — unified workspace for governance tasks, security items and AI
    recommendations.
  - **Quality & Safety monitoring** — automated scoring and trend analysis of AI interactions, with
    configurable metrics across portfolios.
  - **Agent lifecycle management** — **deactivate / reinstate agents in AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI
    and ServiceNow** from Control Tower. Cross-cloud control-plane action on third-party agents.
  - **Risk & compliance integration** — regulatory classifications and compliance posture tracked
    directly on asset records.
  - **Customizable security scoring** with weighted LLM guardrail categories; threat-detection
    metrics for **system prompt leakage, sensitive data disclosure and injection attacks**;
    compliance scoring against configured regulatory frameworks; **risk heat mapping** of inherent
    vs residual risk across portfolios.
  - **AI Service Graph Connectors** — discovery of AI assets from **AWS** (automatic key rotation,
    multi-account), **Microsoft** (Azure ML, Copilot; certificate-based auth), **GCP Vertex AI**,
    **Anthropic**, **OpenAI**, **Databricks** and others.
  - MCP: **global MCP clients** usable across multiple servers; **MCP Catalog** integration for
    server selection; monitoring charts for MCP server access; agent publishing via an **"External
    Registry" integration with Microsoft**.

**AI Gateway — DEPRECATED in the Australia release and no longer supported.** Legacy MCP
client-server interactions remain visible through AI Gateway. [DEPRECATION — not reported as a
finding, but it retires the surface the May 2026 press release promised, so the original
"AI Gateway GA" watch is closed as superseded rather than fulfilled.]

## NEW APPLICATION THIS SCAN — MCP Server Console
servicenow.com/docs/r/release-notes/mcp-server-console-rn.html
**New application in the Australia release.** Plugin **Model Context Protocol Server
(`sn_mcp_server`)**, version 1.3. Enables secure, governed access to ServiceNow instance
functionality for AI applications via MCP servers. Capabilities:
  - Unified MCP server creation with **embedded OAuth client registration**.
  - **Tool creation from Subflows, Actions, REST APIs, Knowledge Graphs and Now Assist skills.**
  - Preconfigured **Quickstart Server** for incident and case record operations.
  - Administrator **annotation configuration** across all supported tool types.
  - **Third-party identity provider (IDP)** integration for user authentication; OAuth 2.0 client
    connectivity.
  - **MCP app creation** for interactive tool interfaces with client-side display, aligned to the
    MCP spec.
Integrates with **AI Control Tower** (observability/governance) and **Machine Identity Console**
(OAuth inbound integrations). Requires a Now Assist application deployment; Foundation, Advanced or
Prime tier.
Corroborating vendor/partner coverage: the **Action Fabric MCP Server** is GA in every Now Assist
and AI Native SKU; any MCP-compatible AI agent can discover and execute governed ServiceNow
actions; **Anthropic Claude integration is live** (Claude can trigger workflows, catalog actions and
approvals through the MCP Server).

## Context, not reported
**Machine Identity Console** — introduced in the **Zurich** release (prior family), enhanced in
Australia; manages machine identities / OAuth inbound integrations. Not new in Australia, so held
below the bar, but it is the identity surface the MCP Server Console depends on and is not in
Zenity's coverage.

Australia "Generative AI offerings" release-note topics (fuller list than prior captures):
AI Experiences, AI Desktop Actions, AI Control Tower, Content Understanding, Document Intelligence,
Generative AI Controller, Knowledge Graph, **MCP Server Console**, Predictive Intelligence,
ServiceNow AI Lens. Standalone AI topics: AI Search, AI Agent Advisor, AI Agent Studio,
AI Admin Center, Now Assist in Document Intelligence. Now Assist (ServiceNow Otto) variants across
~17 product lines.

Already GA and previously cached (not reportable): AI Agent Advisor, Intelligent Approvals (GA May
2026), AI Admin Center / Now Assist Center, AI Desktop Actions, AI Agent Studio.

servicenow.com/docs/ landing page: renders navigation chrome only (release-family links: Zurich,
Yokohama, Xanadu). No extractable AI content — recurring limitation.

Updated: 2026-08-10 — held AI Control Tower item RESOLVED; new MCP Server Console application
found. Both reported 2026-08-10. Lesson: read the per-application `*-rn.html` release notes, not
the family index — the family index asserts nothing.
